package.name: trnav_qd_kinematics
package.description: QD (Quad-Drive diagonal) platform kinematics: QdInverseKinematics (DualSteer IK), QdCrabInverseKinematics (CRAB sideways IK), QdBicycleModel. Pure math (stdlib only, no ROS). Moved out of trnav_motion_qd per AD-012 amendment (2026-07-04) to collect QD/DD kinematics under src/Control/Kinematics/. Identifiers keep the AD-012 triple prefix (files qd_*, classes Qd*, namespace trnav::motion::qd).
